page: Amazon Web Services m7i.4xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8488C processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by a 105 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 5 GHz, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions and Advanced Matrix Extensions.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be handled via network-attached options. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across most standard compute and memory workloads. The instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 10710.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 23157.79. In memory bandwidth testing, it recorded 75.78 GB/sec for large-block read-only operations. For specialized tasks, it demonstrates strong performance in text generation using a small 135M LLM model at 333.79 tokens/sec, while medium 7B model text generation operates at an average rate of 15.01 tokens/sec. Redis SET operations average 20.92 million operations per second. These characteristics make the instance suitable for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, static web serving, and database operations.
